thread:
lina: Reminder: micro-cohort pricing experiment (cohort 'micro-E') starts tomorrow 06:00 PT. Need final reconciliation plan + invoice adjustments for any negative deltas. @omar @nishi can you confirm refund policy and invoice tagging?

omar: I'm reviewing the refund flow. We currently create credit_notes for deltas > $0 and manual refunds for >$2k. For the experiment we should auto-issue credits up to $500 and flag >$500 for review. Agree?

nishi: Agree with auto credits up to $500. Also we need an invoice_tag 'pilot_microE' so downstream reconciler picks it up. I'll add the tag to the billing transform.

kevin_fin: Can you make sure vendor pass-through rates are applied? Last time we missed the vendor delta for GPU minutes and that broke margins. Which ratecard_id are we using?

omar: Using ratecard_id=rp_micro_v1. Vendors: gpu_vendor_rate updated to 0.18/min in vendor sheet v2. @nishi please map gpu_vendor_rate -> vendor_gpu_min in the invoice calc.

nishi: Will do. Also adding a validation to compare vendor_gpu_min * gpu_minutes to recorded vendor_charge, and flag mismatches > 1%.

lina: Ops: what is the rollback signal? We want to auto-stop the cohort if net invoice delta across cohort > 15% or if reconciliation error rate > 0.8%.

omar: Ack. I'll add a gating alert to billing-monitoring. It will post to #eng-sre and trigger a temporary cohort-block.

kevin_fin: Can finance get a preflight CSV by 11:30 PT? Columns: acct_id, old_amount, new_amount, delta_usd, credit_action. Please include a 'reason' column for any flagged items.

nishi: I'll run the preview job and produce preflight_microE.csv. Preview job id: 32211. Link will be uploaded to shared drive.

deploy-bot: billing-preview job started (id=32211) at 2140000007. Logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/32211

lina: Legal wants bill language for grandfathered subs: suggested: "Your subscription includes a temporary legacy credit period during the first 14 days of the pricing pilot." Good to go?

kevin_fin: That wording is fine. Also confirm we include a line on invoice credits saying "automatically applied" when applicable.

nishi: Preflight uploaded: https://files.redwood/preflight/32211/preflight_microE.csv. Summary: avg delta +0.6%, 4 accounts > $500 auto-credit applied, 2 accounts flagged > $2k for manual review. Vendor mismatch check found 3 mismatches (all due to late vendor sheet update) -> flagged.

lina: Great. Final checklist: vendor mapping done 705, refund thresholds set 705, tags applied 705, preflight posted 705. Launch at 06:00 PT. If any gating alert fires, we'll pause and notify finance.

kevin_fin: Thanks. I'll standby for the alert channel. If the two >$2k accounts need manual refunds, please loop me in.

omar: Creating a short runbook for post-launch refunds and credit notes. Will post link in thread when ready.

lina: Perfect. Good luck everyone :rocket:
